hidden.why: Points balance. The lounge only needs 'Silver or above' (>= 5000); the exact balance and whether the member is Gold reveal travel volume / spending.
Member identity; lounge entries must not identify or link the member.
Leaf position identifies the member's statement.

mayReveal.why: Only the Merkle root, already public.
A salted commitment computed off chain by the issuer.

acceptedLeakage: Transaction fee payer / submission time are outside the contract (the lounge kiosk can submit on the member's behalf).
Without a nullifier, a member can share their secret with a friend; accepted for this design (the gate staff check a boarding pass).

unlinkable.why: Two visits by the same member must not be linkable.
A visit must not point at the member's statement.
